name: layout
description: AppShell, AppHeader, AppNav, PageHeader, primitives, InstallButton, ThemeToggle, design tokens
postInstall: Render `<AppShell>` inside the router, as the root layout route around `<Outlet />` (the router template ships it as src/App.tsx) — AppNav's links need the router
Give every page a `<PageHeader title=…>` — it is the page's <h1>

Set the color accent: the `--accent-h` value in theme.css. Take your app's slot from the hue table in https://github.com/daniel-rck/web-base/blob/main/docs/specs/04-layout-system.md (355 is the free one) — never edit tokens.css, web-base owns it
Prevent theme flash: add `<script src="/theme-init.js"></script>` to <head> in index.html, before your stylesheet
If the app persists the theme somewhere other than localStorage["theme"], adapt public/theme-init.js to read it
